Same-role copies have identical non-empty neighborhoods in $G_1$, forming a length-2 walk via any shared neighbor. Different-role copies have disjoint template neighborhoods, giving shortest paths of length 3 through $G_1$ interiors.
* **Collapse Homomorphism & Non-$D2$:** The edge-preserving retraction maps every new copy $(b, h)$ to its base center $c_h$ in $G_1$. This collapse fixes $G_1$ and preserves edge relations, proving no length-2 shortcut can exist between any pair at distance 3 in $G_1$.

    $$380323 \;—\; 342225 \;—\; 5265 \;—\; 342290.$$
  * Target 94: Last-block hub $397227$ to base clone $342290$ has measured distance 3 via walk:
    $$397227 \;—\; 342225 \;—\; 5265 \;—\; 342290.$$
* **Prefix Validity:** Clones added in any order retain all covering walks through $G_1$ interiors at insertion, maintaining diameter $\le 3$ and degree bound $\le 82 + r$ across all prefixes.
